findings.summary: R2 was based on 1abc388 while canonical main had advanced to 2b3573606570f910e5569cf3306223354f93e4ac, including Phase 4 source and tests.
R2 omitted exact Supervisor guards in acceptance, canary, cycle, discover, promote, restore, scheduler, portfolio, mini-gates, capability registry, and the shared evolution authority leaf.
R3 preserves emergency STOP before financial-family denial and adds a valid-envelope regression assertion.
The deterministic 47-row R12 campaign remains present and is exercised by the R3 convergence suite.
R3 state is rebound to the current canonical head, candidate worktree, fresh test hashes, runtime probe, and verifier lifecycle.
The shared candidate venv had an old editable checkout ahead of R2; all R3 gates force PYTHONPATH to the R3 source and record the imported module path.
